bucle.dash:
Main
    x = 0
    for i in (1..300000)
        x = x + i * 3
        if x > 1000000
            x = x - 1000000
        end
    end
    Print x
end

llamada.dash:
func f(n, i)
    r = n + i
    if r > 1000000
        r = r - 1000000
    end
    return r
end

Main
    y = 0
    for i in (1..100000)
        y = f(y, i)
    end
    Print y
end
llamada.blitz:

Function.l f{n.l,i.l}
  r.l=n+i
  If r>1000000 Then r=r-1000000
  Function Return r
End Function
y=0
For i=1 To 100000
  y=f{y,i}
Next
NPrint y
End
